requirement.normalizedRequirement: Every exposed escape route shall have accessible_status = true, safe_status = true, and documented ice/snow mitigation coverage.

requirement.sourceText: Exposed escape routes shall remain accessible and safe, taking into consideration the potential icing of structures and snow accumulation.
